# XCDR1 bodies of the corpus samples serialized as parameter lists, in the
# form DDS-XTypes 1.3 7.4.1.2.2 specifies (lines 6102-6124 of the text): the
# long member length is the exact length of the member, without the padding
# that follows it, and the member header carries FLAG_2 (must understand)
# for a key member (7.2.2.4.4.4.8: key members always must be understood).
# Cyclone DDS 0.11 writes the padded length and never sets FLAG_2; it reads
# both forms. Derived from cyclone_vectors.txt by `cyclone_reader spec`: the
# exact length of each member is the smallest one Cyclone's reader accepts
# with the same sample read back; the key member ids are given (Keyed: 0, 1).
